note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the Stridsvagn 122. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. It publishes the mass, the gun-forward length, the width, the height, the ground clearance, the engine model, the engine rating as 1,500 PS (1,479 hp) with no net basis, the transmission model, the maximum road speed and the internal-fuel range. It publishes no track shoe width, no track pitch and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
